points.description: Setup: labels the data as positive/negative (+/-, e.g. +1/-1) and initialises the weights (randomly or to small/zero values).

Iterative update loop: repeatedly goes over the data points (epochs) and, for a misclassified point (e.g. <w,x> <= 0 for the correctly signed/flipped input), updates the weights with Δw = eta*x (or equivalent, e.g. w += eta*y*x), stopping when the weights no longer change (or no misclassifications remain / change is small). Equivalent wording, pseudo code form or an equivalent update rule earns the mark.
